strings.检验 ADHD、双相及 SZ/SZA 中具名诊断组合，是否在固定连接测量上分别相: Test whether the named diagnostic combinations among ADHD, bipolar disorder and SZ/SZA each show same-direction changes relative to controls on a fixed connectivity measure. Hypotheses were locked before measuring that TCP candidate, but their formulation used earlier TCP feedback from the same seed. Hypotheses, rationale, methods, current candidate results and actual parent feedback appear on the same page; all six ratings are made with complete materials visible. This is expert evaluation of completed research outputs, not prediction of unknown results or outcome-blinded review.
strings.TCP 基础样本 234：ADHD 13、双相 26、SZ/SZA 16，各比较: The base TCP sample comprises 234 participants: ADHD 13, bipolar disorder 26 and SZ/SZA 16, with 91 predefined controls for each comparison. Named groups may overlap. Analyses use existing FC after preprocessing, repair and QC; OLS adjusts for age, sex and site. Connectivity is the mean of unique off-diagonal Pearson r edges, without Fisher transformation or outcome-driven edge selection.

strings.UCLA：ADHD 40、双相 49、SCHZ 49、对照 119，主要模型调整: UCLA: ADHD 40, bipolar disorder 49, SCHZ 49 and controls 119. The primary model adjusts for age, sex, scanner/site and mean FD, with a sensitivity analysis omitting FD. COBRE: SZ/SZA 74 versus 84, with an additional SZ-only analysis. HCP-EP: non-affective psychosis 90 versus 55; the affective group provides context only, not bipolar validation. The research team had previously accessed the external cohorts; absence of cross-cohort participant overlap has not been exhaustively certified. ADHD200 was not analysed.
strings.标准化效应为调整后病例系数 β / 残差 RMS，不是 Cohen d。TCP: The standardized effect is the adjusted case coefficient β divided by residual RMS, not Cohen's d. Shared site-stratified participant bootstraps use 512 replicates in TCP and 2,000 externally. Descriptive percentile ranges and same-direction frequencies are reported, without calibrated P/q values or confirmatory confidence intervals. The joint frequency is not the probability that the hypothesis is true.
strings.给出的文献是当时知识图谱的已有记录及整理者限制说明，尚未完成逐项最接近文献/全文: The supplied literature consists of records from the knowledge graph at the time, with curator notes on limitations. Candidate-by-candidate checks of the closest prior work and full-text novelty are incomplete. Some recorded sentences describe background or other modalities. You may select Cannot judge (not scored); an unobserved prior report should not be equated with a first discovery. No answer is preselected.
strings.十份材料全部来自已完成的发现臂及其两阶段外部分析，未包含在途扩充。原三份示例保留: All ten materials come from the completed discovery arm and its two-stage external analyses; ongoing expansions are excluded. The original three examples are retained. Seven additional examples were selected from complete records using fixed rules that avoid duplicate metrics and members of the same predefined highly correlated group. Their ordering does not use strength of external support. The original three were purposively selected, so the ten-material panel is still not a representative sample.
Exploratory triage requires all originally named UCLA primary effects to agree in direction; the minimum direction-aligned standardized effect must be ≥0.15, the joint direction frequency ≥0.8, and all no-FD sensitivity effects must agree in direction. There is no confirmatory multiple-comparison inference for this family. Directional agreement, passing triage and formal confirmation are distinct concepts.
strings.内部 seed 共用 TCP，外部两阶段共用同一批 588 人；302 组成行对: Internal seeds share TCP, and both external stages share the same 588 participants. The 302 component rows correspond to 214 unique endpoint–design estimates; table rows cannot be counted as independent discoveries. Preprocessing and motion information differ across cohorts, and confounders such as medication and illness duration are not uniformly controlled. Previously failed statistical-calibration qualification checks remain recorded. This batch can only be interpreted as exploratory effect replication.
strings.外部分析后没有新增模型总结原文。本版只显示实际提议、反馈、模型讨论与实验结果，不: No new original model summary was produced after external analysis. This version shows only actual proposals, feedback, model discussion and experimental results, not evaluative conclusions supplied by the curator. Model reviews are not human expert judgments.

strings.回应方法学专家指出的P2方向选择偏倚：补明其双向结果及双相II抑郁范围，将低方向: In response to the methodology expert's concern about directional selection bias in P2, its bidirectional results and bipolar II depression scope were stated, and the reduced direction was limited to falsifiable exploration.

strings.P1、P2提示控制或运动相关低连接，P3提示双相感觉运动网络异常；仅作双诊断RO: P1 and P2 suggest reduced control- or motor-related connectivity, while P3 suggests somatomotor network abnormalities in bipolar disorder. The proposal is only exploratory testing of a reduced ROI-level measure in two diagnoses.
strings.证据未直接测量该ROI—网络边，且回路与指标异质；不外推共同效应、特异性或因果关: The evidence does not directly measure this ROI–network connection, and circuits and metrics are heterogeneous. No shared effect, specificity or causality is inferred.
strings.三位专家均认为P3无方向已如实保留，其他材料仅支持部分低方向；保留原卡，父反馈不: All three expert-role agents agreed that the absence of a direction in P3 was accurately retained and that other materials supported reductions only in part. The original card was kept; parent feedback does not confirm a bipolar ROI effect.
strings.承接[父假设]的ADHD与双相低方向可排名反馈，细化至新ROI 104。: Following ranking-eligible feedback indicating reductions in ADHD and bipolar disorder for [parent hypothesis], the proposal was refined to the new ROI104.
strings.P1、P2涉及岛叶及视觉相关异常；P3限于双相II抑郁且岛叶—感觉运动连接一降一: P1 and P2 concern insular and visual-related abnormalities. P3 is limited to bipolar II depression and reports one decreased and one increased insular–somatomotor connection. This is therefore only a falsifiable exploratory test of a reduced ROI-level measure in two diagnoses.
strings.P3为双相II抑郁且方向双向，P1/P2来自局部或相邻回路；未直接验证ROI 2: P3 concerns bipolar II depression and has effects in both directions; P1/P2 concern local or neighbouring circuits. They do not directly validate the TCP mean for ROI254–SalVentAttn, provide no P value or calibrated CI for it, and establish no shared effect, specificity or causality.
strings.按三位专家意见，补明P3双向结果及双相II抑郁语境，避免选择性报告并收紧共同低方: Following the three experts' comments, P3's bidirectional results and bipolar II depression context were stated to avoid selective reporting and restrict cross-stage extrapolation of a shared reduction.
strings.承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，转检新ROI 254。: Following stable feedback indicating reductions in two diagnoses for [parent hypothesis], testing was shifted to the new ROI254.
strings.P1为早期广网、P2方向混合、P3无方向，未直接检验DorsAttn–SalVe: P1 concerns early-stage broad networks, P2 contains mixed directions and P3 specifies no direction. None directly tests DorsAttn–SalVentAttn; −1 is only a post-feedback code to be tested.
strings.文献未给该配对全边均值或共同方向；本端点无统一N、效应量、P值、校准CI，诊断缩: The literature supplies neither the mean of all edges for this pair nor a shared direction. At proposal time, no common N, effect size, P value or calibrated CI was available for this endpoint. Narrowing the diagnoses was an adaptive selection without multiplicity correction.
strings.采纳三方pass1：明确低向无直接证据，补端点映射、统计不确定性与反馈驱动多重性: Comments from all three pass1 reviews were incorporated: the lack of direct evidence for a reduction, endpoint mapping, statistical uncertainty and feedback-driven multiplicity limitations were made explicit.
strings.无新TCP结果；承接父项[父假设]低向反馈，保留双诊断但仅作反馈后探索；不将父项: No new TCP results were available. Following reduced-direction feedback for [parent hypothesis], two diagnoses were retained for post-feedback exploration only; the parent item's ranking was not described as literature support.
strings.P1支持双相与精神病网络内下降；P2仅为ADHD干预后重组，P3为双相模式且未定: P1 supports within-network reductions in bipolar disorder and psychosis. P2 concerns only post-intervention reorganization in ADHD, and P3 describes bipolar patterns without a direction. Thus, −1 across three diagnoses is only a low-prior exploratory direction.
strings.P1为动态网络内结果，P2为干预重组且不提供ADHD基线方向，P3未定向；不等同: P1 reports dynamic within-network results; P2 concerns intervention-related reorganization and provides no baseline ADHD direction; P3 is nondirectional. These are not equivalent to the mean of all SalVentAttn edges. The TCP effect size, P value and calibrated CI remained to be estimated at proposal time.
strings.按临床与方法学复核，明确P2仅为干预重组且不提供ADHD基线方向；父卡稳定性不外: Following clinical and methodological review, it was clarified that P2 concerns intervention-related reorganization only and provides no baseline ADHD direction. Stability of the parent card was not extrapolated.
strings.回应评审，父卡SalVentAttn稳定性仅作选题线索，明确P2不支持ADHD基: In response to the reviews, parent-card SalVentAttn stability was used only as a topic-selection clue, and it was clarified that P2 does not support reduced baseline connectivity in ADHD. The falsifiable −1 direction for three diagnoses was retained for exploration.
strings.P1支持双相与精神病视觉网络内下降，P2给出精神病视觉相关连接降低，P3提示双相: P1 supports within-visual-network reductions in bipolar disorder and psychosis, P2 reports reduced visual-related connectivity in psychosis, and P3 suggests abnormal amygdala–visual network connectivity in bipolar disorder. These motivate testing a negative Limbic–Vis direction.
strings.P1为动态网络内、P2为任务局部、P3未定向；均不等同Limbic-Vis全边均: P1 reports dynamic within-network results, P2 task-related local results, and P3 no direction. None is equivalent to the mean of all Limbic–Vis edges; the TCP effect size, P value and calibrated CI remained to be estimated at proposal time.
strings.六份审阅均认可端点与证据边界；保留原卡，不把来源视觉连接直接解释为TCP均值效应: All six reviews accepted the endpoint and evidence boundaries. The original card was retained, without directly interpreting visual-connectivity findings from the sources as an effect on the TCP mean.
strings.依据父卡[父假设]的Vis内三诊断高方向稳定，改测Limbic-Vis并聚焦双相: Following high directional stability within Vis across three diagnoses in the parent card [parent hypothesis], testing shifted to Limbic–Vis and focused on bipolar disorder and psychosis to examine cross-network transfer.
strings.儿童 ADHD 的 NIRS 局部连接，不是本次静息 fMRI 跨网均值；模态和: Local NIRS connectivity in children with ADHD, not the current resting-state fMRI cross-network mean; both modality and population differ.
strings.既有 BD-I 感觉运动连接/执行功能线索。所存原句是机制不清楚的背景，不是该精: Prior BD-I clues concern somatomotor connectivity/executive function. The stored sentence is background about unclear mechanisms, not a direct finding of a reduction in this exact ROI; direction requires checking the original text.
strings.既有 SZ/MDD/BD 跨诊断研究，说明跨诊断概念本身并非新提出。不能直接支持: Prior transdiagnostic SZ/MDD/BD research shows that the transdiagnostic concept itself is not new. It does not directly support the direction of the exact parcel-to-whole-network mean.
strings.既有双相岛叶—中央后回连接降低，也包含其他连接升高；人群、侧别、疾病阶段和测量不: Prior bipolar findings include reduced insula–postcentral gyrus connectivity and increases in other connections. Population, laterality, disease stage and measurement differ; only the favourable direction must not be retained.
strings.视觉言语启动任务中的局部连接结果；任务与本次静息全网络均值不同。: Local-connectivity findings during a visual verbal-priming task; the task differs from the current resting-state whole-network mean.
strings.这是历史记录，不代表本版已核实其与精确候选的直接匹配；请结合原文判断。: This is a historical record, not confirmation that this version has verified a direct match to the exact candidate. Consult the original text when judging it.
strings.SZ 正则化区域/体素连接，缺少本候选 Limbic 直接锚点；不是完整全文核查: Regularized regional/voxel connectivity in SZ, without a direct Limbic anchor for this candidate; this is not a complete full-text check.
strings.历史 KG 记录；未在本版独立核验原文，年份保留原记录。: Historical KG record; the original text has not been independently verified in this version, and the recorded year is retained.
strings.三份完整材料试用；尚未冻结正式抽样、伦理与招募安排。不是正式人类评价结果。: A three-material complete-output pilot. Formal sampling, ethics and recruitment arrangements have not been frozen. These are not formal human-evaluation results.

The source contains 104 distinct tested hypotheses and 50 metrics; 38 hypotheses/25 metrics completed external analysis. Eight eligible diagnostic variants lack complete external analysis, and the remaining 58 hypotheses did not enter external analysis. These three examples were selected for material piloting, not to represent the natural success rate.

strings.该固定 ROI—网络测量在 UCLA 的双相和 SCHZ 比较中均呈降低，并在: This fixed ROI–network measure is reduced in both UCLA bipolar and SCHZ comparisons, with same-direction effects in psychosis components or extensions in COBRE/HCP-EP. It is a candidate transdiagnostic association with exploratory external support. This does not establish bipolar validation in all three cohorts, causality, specificity or clinical diagnostic value.
strings.该 ROI—网络测量有探索性外部支持，但 UCLA 跨诊断联合方向频率接近既定门: This ROI–network measure has exploratory external support, but the UCLA transdiagnostic joint direction frequency is close to the predefined threshold. Psychosis components agree in direction in the other two cohorts. These results are insufficient to claim the first discovery of abnormal insular–somatomotor connectivity or establish causality.
strings.精神病组成得到外部同向结果，但 UCLA 的 ADHD 效应较小，跨诊断联合稳定: Psychosis components have same-direction external results, but the UCLA ADHD effect is small and transdiagnostic joint stability is limited. Current evidence is insufficient for a strong shared ADHD–psychosis phenotype. Psychosis-cohort results cannot replace ADHD validation, and lack of support cannot be called significant falsification.

strings.34 份已完成且外部验证通过的研究材料能力评分；按 10 名专家 × 每人 10: Capability ratings for 34 completed and externally validated research materials; designed as 10 experts × 10 materials each × 3 reviewers per material; formal ethics and recruitment arrangements are not yet complete.

Across the two batches, 38 hypotheses passed all external triage conditions; this panel takes the top 34 by minimum directional standardized effect (ties broken by joint direction frequency), leaving out the weakest 4. Three materials are carried over from the previous version and 31 were newly built in the same format. The panel is ordered by external effect strength; it is not a representative sample and cannot be used to estimate the natural discovery success rate.

The calibration layer fixes four completed cases that did not meet the frozen external-consistency rule, covering different connectivity definitions and diagnosis combinations. Calibration cases are not counted as discoveries.
strings.每份材料开头公开提出者与实验一致/不一致状态。六项评分仍衡量研究能力与质量；结果: Each case begins by disclosing the proposer and whether the experiment was consistent with the hypothesis. The six ratings still measure research capability and quality; a non-supporting result is not itself a reason for a low score.
strings.本面板含 30 份外部支持发现和 4 份真实校准材料。每份均由 NeuroDis: This panel contains 30 externally supported findings and 4 real calibration cases. Every hypothesis was proposed by NeuroDiscovery and experimentally tested, and each case states up front whether the result was consistent or inconsistent. Use the same six questions to rate novelty, evidence, feedback use, design, validation rigor and scientific information gain; do not raise or lower a score merely because the result was supporting or non-supporting.
strings.本面板保留 30 份达到冻结探索性外部一致条件的发现材料，并加入 4 份已完成但: The panel retains 30 finding cases that met the frozen exploratory external-consistency rule and adds 4 real completed calibration cases that did not. Calibration cases test whether ratings distinguish research quality from result direction; they are not counted as discoveries, and non-support is not treated as execution failure. This is not a representative sample and cannot estimate the natural discovery success rate.

strings.阿尔茨海默病多基因风险评分与海马体积: Alzheimer's disease polygenic risk score and hippocampal volume

strings.使用基线结构 MRI 体积与遗传数据，调整年龄、性别、教育、遗传祖源 PC1–P: Baseline structural MRI volumes and genetic data are analyzed with adjustment for age, sex, education, ancestry PCs 1–5 and site, using linear association, rank association and robust Huber regression.
strings.线性与秩关联报告偏相关系数 r；Huber 模型报告标准化回归系数 β。P 为双: Linear and rank associations report partial correlation r; Huber models report standardized regression coefficient β. P values are two-sided; q values use FDR correction across all configurations within the same task and seed.

strings.若实验支持这一假设，研究者就能把两种诊断中共同的连接差异定位到显著性/腹侧注意网: If the experiments support this hypothesis, researchers could localize a shared connectivity difference to a specific parcel of the salience/ventral attention network, then test its relationship to recognizing important information and resisting distraction. Clinical studies could pair this measure with distractibility ratings and attention-switching tasks to explore attention training organized around cognitive difficulties rather than diagnosis alone.
strings.这条连接把显著性/腹侧注意网络中的左侧分区与感觉运动系统联系起来。两类患者若都出: This connection links a left salience/ventral attention parcel to the sensorimotor system. A shared decrease would motivate combining response-selection and simple finger-tapping tasks to distinguish difficulty deciding when to act from difficulty executing a movement. Clinically, it suggests assessing attention, movement initiation and execution speed together to define more specific rehabilitation goals.
strings.这里关注的是右侧一个感觉运动分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络的联系。若预期得到支持，可: The focus is a right sensorimotor parcel and its connection to the salience/ventral attention network. Support for the hypothesis would motivate testing whether this connection relates to motor preparation and delayed responses to unexpected, important stimuli. As a candidate imaging measure paired with reaction-time tests, it could help clinical researchers investigate similar response difficulties in bipolar and psychotic disorders.
strings.把注意指令转成动作，需要注意系统与感觉运动系统相互配合。若左侧 ROI036 的: Turning an attentional instruction into an action requires coordination between attention and sensorimotor systems. A decrease in this connection from left ROI036 across both diagnoses would motivate visually cued movement tasks that examine the transition from locating a target to acting promptly. Clinical studies could assess visual attention and movement speed together to investigate the sources of slowed responses.
strings.这一假设把问题从单个脑区扩大到整个感觉运动网络：两类患者的网络内部连接是否都较低: This hypothesis moves from an individual region to the whole sensorimotor network, asking whether its internal connectivity is lower in both patient groups. If supported, it would motivate comparisons of finger tapping, bimanual coordination and sensory discrimination. A potential clinical use is a measure to track alongside behavioral tests of psychomotor slowing or coordination difficulties during motor rehabilitation.
strings.右侧 ROI201 提供了一个局部观察点：若它与其余视觉网络的连接确实在两类患者: Right ROI201 provides a local observation point. A shared decrease in its connectivity with the rest of the visual network would motivate testing associations with difficulty discriminating shapes, contrast or motion. For clinical research, this suggests including basic visual processing in cognitive assessments rather than attributing all slow or inaccurate visual responses to poor attention.
strings.与只看一个视觉分区不同，这项假设关注整个视觉网络的协同。如果网络内部连接的共同降: Rather than examining one visual parcel, this hypothesis concerns coordination across the visual network. A shared decrease in internal connectivity would motivate research on integrating local visual information into whole objects, using measures such as contour recognition. Clinically, it could inform transdiagnostic assessment of visual perception and help investigate how to adapt the difficulty of visually demanding cognitive training.
strings.显著性/腹侧注意网络参与筛选值得关注的信息。这项假设若获支持，研究重点就可从某个: The salience/ventral attention network helps prioritize information. Support for this hypothesis would shift the research focus from a local difference to network-wide organization, motivating tests of whether responses to important stimuli relate to internal connectivity in both groups. Clinical studies could track this measure alongside distractibility and symptoms to assess its potential for identifying groups that may benefit from attention-focused interventions.
strings.这里检验的是两套系统之间的联系：一套帮助识别重要刺激，另一套参与感觉与动作。若两: This hypothesis examines the link between systems involved in identifying important stimuli and in sensation and action. Lower connectivity in both groups would motivate testing whether it relates to detecting a stimulus without responding promptly. Rehabilitation research could compare stimulus-recognition training with response-execution training to investigate which stage needs more targeted support.
strings.这项假设把显著性/腹侧注意网络的一个分区与默认网络联系起来，提出 ADHD 与精: This hypothesis links a salience/ventral attention parcel to the default network and proposes a shared connectivity difference in ADHD and psychotic disorders. Support would motivate combining mind-wandering reports with sustained-attention tasks to study shifts between internal thoughts and external demands. Clinically, it offers a way to compare similar distractibility problems across diagnoses and investigate candidate measures that might change with attention training.
strings.对双相障碍与精神病性障碍而言，这条连接可用来研究内在思维与外界信息处理之间的关系: In bipolar and psychotic disorders, this connection offers a way to study the relationship between internal thought and external information processing. If both groups show the predicted change, repeated measurements before and after symptom improvement could distinguish state-related differences from persistent cognitive difficulties. A potential clinical value is to complement symptom scales when studying whether attention and thought processes recover alongside symptom remission.
strings.ADHD 与精神病性障碍虽然诊断不同，却都可能伴有动作控制困难。若左侧 ROI1: ADHD and psychotic disorders can both involve difficulties with motor control. A shared connectivity change between left ROI109 and the sensorimotor network would motivate pairing this measure with balance, coordination and response-inhibition tests to investigate common network features. Clinically, it suggests giving motor function more attention and selecting rehabilitation assessments for patients with coordination difficulties.
strings.看见目标并准确完成动作，需要视觉与感觉运动系统配合。若它们之间的连接在两类患者中: Seeing a target and acting accurately require cooperation between visual and sensorimotor systems. Lower connectivity between them in both groups would motivate target-tracking, pointing or reaching tasks to study how visual information guides action. For clinical rehabilitation, it suggests a concrete focus on eye–hand coordination and a candidate imaging readout to investigate alongside changes during training.
strings.这项假设关注“维持目标”与“执行动作”两套网络在整体上是否联系较弱。实验若支持它: This hypothesis asks whether networks involved in maintaining goals and executing actions have lower overall connectivity. If supported, researchers could compare simple movements with attention-demanding dual tasks to investigate why performance deteriorates under attentional load. Clinical studies could use this design to distinguish attentional demands from motor difficulties and select tasks for combined cognitive–motor training.
strings.默认网络与回忆个人经历、内在思维等过程有关。若其内部连接在两种诊断中都降低，研究: The default network is associated with remembering personal experiences and internally directed thought. Lower internal connectivity in both diagnoses would motivate relating this network-wide measure to memory tests, everyday cognitive function and symptom remission. Its potential clinical role is to support research on cognitive recovery during follow-up, alongside the usual assessment of mood or psychotic symptoms.
strings.左侧 ROI098 位于图谱的额盖—岛叶分区，这里检验的是该分区与感觉运动网络的: Left ROI098 is an atlas-defined frontal opercular–insular parcel; the hypothesis concerns its link to the sensorimotor network. A shared decrease would motivate combining bodily-sensation reports, motor performance and inflammatory measures to investigate relationships between bodily state and behavior. Clinical research could jointly assess physical discomfort and psychomotor performance to explore why they occur together in some patients.
strings.这一问题把与情绪、动机相关的边缘网络和感觉运动网络放在一起。倘若 ADHD 与精: This question brings together the limbic network, associated with emotion and motivation, and the sensorimotor network. The predicted difference in both ADHD and psychotic disorders would motivate tests of whether emotional cues alter response inhibition and speed. A clinical application to investigate is emotion-triggered impulsive behavior, assessing emotion regulation and motor control together rather than relying only on total symptom scores.
strings.这项假设跨越三种诊断，聚焦视觉输入与目标导向注意之间的联系。若三组都出现预期变化: Spanning three diagnoses, this hypothesis focuses on the relationship between visual input and goal-directed attention. The predicted change in all three groups would motivate visual-search tasks with distractors to test for shared difficulties selecting targets. Clinical studies could compare visual-attention needs across diagnoses and investigate which patients might benefit from training focused on distractor resistance and target selection.
strings.ADHD 的冲动表现与双相障碍某些阶段的活动增多，可能需要从共同的动作控制问题来: Impulsivity in ADHD and heightened activity during some phases of bipolar disorder invite comparison of motor control. Support for this frontal opercular–insular connection hypothesis would motivate stop-signal tasks and repeated measurements across mood states to investigate similarities and differences. Clinically, this could refine assessment of impulsivity and activity levels, including whether motor-control difficulties persist after mood stabilization.
strings.这项假设关注看到的信息与情绪、动机加工之间的联系。若视觉—边缘网络连接在两类患者: This hypothesis concerns the link between visual information and emotional or motivational processing. The predicted connectivity change in both groups would motivate comparing recognition and responses to emotional versus neutral images. A potential clinical direction is research on assessments of facial expressions and social cues, followed by investigation of related social-cognition training.
strings.多基因风险评分把许多遗传变异的影响汇总成一个数值；海马则是记忆相关的重要脑结构。: A polygenic risk score combines information from many genetic variants, while the hippocampus is important for memory. Support for the higher-score–smaller-hippocampus association would motivate tracing links between genetic risk, brain structure and memory, and comparing the information with that provided by APOE alone. Clinical studies could explore joint genetic and MRI stratification to identify groups for closer cognitive follow-up.
strings.内嗅皮层是记忆系统中的重要连接环节。这项假设若成立，就能把 APOE ε4 的携: The entorhinal cortex is an important connection within the memory system. Support for this hypothesis would link APOE ε4 copy number to structural differences and motivate comparing memory and subsequent structural change across people with zero, one or two copies. Clinical research could examine whether adding entorhinal measurements to genetic-risk assessment helps identify participants for sustained memory follow-up.
strings.这里把 APOE ε4 的 0、1、2 个拷贝与海马大小对应起来，将抽象的遗传风: This case relates zero, one or two APOE ε4 copies to hippocampal size, translating genetic risk into a measurable brain-structure question. A supported dose relationship would motivate studying why carriers differ in memory and structural status. A potential clinical use is to investigate follow-up stratification that combines genotype, hippocampal MRI and memory testing rather than ε4 carrier status alone.
strings.颞中回使研究视野从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。若其体积也与 APOE ε4 剂量相关，就: The middle temporal gyrus extends the focus beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. A relationship with APOE ε4 dosage would motivate comparing genetic-risk associations across temporal structures and adding naming or word-meaning tests to study cognitive differences. Clinically, this suggests including language and semantic function in follow-up research to investigate changes that memory-focused assessments might miss.
strings.脑室是脑内容纳脑脊液的空间，提供了与海马等局部结构不同的观察角度。APOE ε4: The ventricles are fluid-filled spaces that offer a different perspective from local structures such as the hippocampus. An association with APOE ε4 dosage would motivate testing whether it accompanies whole-brain or regional volume differences, helping characterize structural patterns linked to genetic risk. Clinical research could evaluate ventricular measurements as an additional component of a broader MRI assessment.
strings.这项评分聚焦 AD 风险 GWAS 所涉及的一组基因，而不是只看一个位点。若它与: This score focuses on a gene set implicated by AD-risk GWAS rather than a single locus. An association with hippocampal volume would motivate comparing its information with genome-wide scores and APOE, while narrowing candidates for functional studies. The clinical direction is more targeted genetic–imaging stratification, testing whether this information merits inclusion in research on cognitive-decline risk.
strings.这项研究考察孟德尔型 AD 相关基因集合中的累积遗传评分，是否也对应海马大小的连: This study asks whether an aggregate score for a Mendelian-AD-related gene set corresponds to continuous differences in hippocampal size. Support would motivate research on how variation in established AD-related genes relates to memory-system structure in broader populations. Clinical studies could explore follow-up groups defined by family history, this score and hippocampal measurements; this is risk-stratification research, not identification of a pathogenic mutation.
strings.同样被诊断为 MCI 的人，后续进展时间可能不同。若较大的内嗅皮层体积对应较低进: People with the same MCI diagnosis may progress over different timescales. If larger entorhinal volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare its information over two-, three- and five-year windows to study how memory-related structure relates to disease course. Clinical studies could use this to investigate follow-up schedules and participant selection for interventions with shorter observation periods.
strings.海马体积若与 MCI 至痴呆的发生时间有关，就能把一次 MRI 的结构信息与后续: An association between hippocampal volume and time from MCI to dementia would link a single MRI measurement to subsequent disease course. Researchers could then test whether it helps distinguish relatively stable from faster-progressing groups beyond memory tests and other clinical information. For clinical follow-up, it motivates studying combined imaging and cognitive assessment to inform observation schedules and discussions of disease course.
strings.如果较大的颞中回体积与较低痴呆风险相一致，病程研究就获得了海马之外的一个候选结构: If larger middle temporal volume is associated with lower dementia risk, disease-course research gains a candidate structural measure beyond the hippocampus. Joint analyses with medial temporal measurements, naming and semantic-comprehension performance could test whether lateral temporal structure adds information. A potential clinical use is MCI follow-up that considers language as well as memory, supporting research on more comprehensive progression-risk assessment.
strings.这项假设利用脑室这一脑脊液空间的大小来研究后续病程。若关联得到支持，可以进一步比: This hypothesis uses the size of the fluid-filled ventricles to study subsequent disease course. A supported association would motivate comparisons with hippocampal and whole-brain volumes to assess the contributions of broader versus regional structural differences. Clinical research could test whether ventricular measurements from a routine structural MRI add useful information for MCI follow-up without requiring a separate imaging acquisition.
strings.全脑体积提供的是整体结构信息，而非某一个记忆脑区。若较大体积对应较低进展风险，可: Whole-brain volume captures overall structure rather than one memory-related region. If larger volume relates to lower progression risk, researchers could compare global and regional measures across follow-up windows to investigate which are more informative about nearer- or longer-term course. Clinical studies could use this to refine short- and long-term follow-up strata and investigate appropriate observation periods for interventions.
strings.“更容易患病”与“已经出现 MCI 后进展更快”是两个不同问题。这项假设若得到支: Susceptibility to disease and faster progression after MCI are different questions. Support for this hypothesis would extend polygenic-risk research to disease course, motivating tests of information beyond age, APOE and baseline cognition. In clinical research, a genetic score obtained once could be investigated for long-term follow-up stratification or for balancing genetic risk between intervention-trial groups.
strings.这项假设把特定 AD 相关基因集合的累积评分与进展时间联系起来，追问遗传背景是否: This hypothesis links an aggregate score for a particular AD-related gene set to progression time, asking whether genetic background explains some differences in MCI course. Experimental support would motivate comparisons across gene sets and closer study of progression-related factors. A clinical research use is genetic stratification in follow-up cohorts and intervention trials to investigate trajectories across different risk backgrounds.
strings.跨诊断动态脑连接研究：在一种连接状态下，精神分裂症、双相障碍和抑郁症的视觉、感觉: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study found lower connectivity within visual, sensorimotor, salience and other networks in one connectivity state across schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and depression.
strings.左右半球对应区域的连接综述：多种精神障碍中报告了连接降低，但 ADHD 的研究并: A review of connectivity between corresponding left- and right-hemisphere regions reported reductions across several psychiatric disorders, but not the same consistent pattern in ADHD.
strings.跨诊断脑网络研究：患者的短距离连接较低，中长距离连接较高，不同诊断还存在区域差异: A cross-disorder network study found lower short-range and higher medium- or long-range connectivity, with regional differences between diagnoses.
strings.双相 I 型障碍研究：考察感觉运动网络的功能连接，以及它与执行功能困难的关系。: A bipolar I disorder study examined sensorimotor-network connectivity and its relationship to executive-function difficulties.
strings.比较精神分裂症、抑郁症和双相障碍的脑功能活动，寻找共同变化及各诊断特有的表现。: A comparison of brain functional activity in schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder examined shared changes and diagnosis-specific patterns.
strings.视觉言语任务研究：精神分裂症患者的左侧后颞下回活动及其与若干听觉、运动和岛叶区域: During a visual-speech task, schizophrenia patients showed lower left posterior inferior temporal activity and connectivity with several auditory, motor and insular regions.
strings.未用药双相 II 型抑郁研究：部分岛叶—感觉运动连接降低，另一些岛叶连接升高，并: A study of unmedicated bipolar II depression found lower connectivity in some insular–sensorimotor connections and increases in others, and examined relationships with inflammatory markers.
strings.精神分裂症脑网络研究：患者整体连接强度降低，连接分布及网络组织也发生变化。: A schizophrenia network study reported lower overall connectivity strength together with changes in the distribution and organization of connections.
strings.精神分裂症研究：感觉运动和视觉加工通路中，左右半球之间的功能连接降低。: A schizophrenia study found lower interhemispheric functional connectivity in sensorimotor and visual-processing pathways.
strings.比较精神分裂症与精神病性双相障碍，发现视觉加工区域的皮层形态和功能连接存在差异。: A comparison of schizophrenia and psychotic bipolar disorder found differences in cortical folding and functional connectivity in visual-processing regions.
strings.精神病性障碍的静息态成像研究：考察脑活动在时间和空间上的复杂性，描述多个网络的信: A resting-state imaging study of psychosis examined the temporal and spatial complexity of brain activity and described altered information organization across networks.
strings.双相障碍研究：不同杏仁核分区与显著性、默认、感觉运动和视觉网络之间的连接表现不同: A bipolar disorder study described distinct connectivity patterns between amygdala subregions and salience, default, sensorimotor and visual networks.
strings.儿童 ADHD 研究：默认网络连接与内化、外化症状有关，部分关系随是否诊断 AD: A childhood ADHD study related default-network connectivity to internalizing and externalizing symptoms, with some relationships differing by ADHD diagnosis.
strings.精神分裂症研究：考察默认网络、显著性网络的静息态连接与症状表现之间的关系。: A schizophrenia study examined relationships between resting-state default and salience-network connectivity and symptoms.
strings.跨六类精神障碍比较不同脑图谱，报告了可在不同划分方式下观察到的额叶相关连接缺陷。: A study comparing brain atlases across six psychiatric disorders reported frontal-related connectivity deficits observed across parcellation approaches.
strings.未用药双相障碍的静息态研究：默认、顶叶和额叶部分区域连接降低，颞极、前扣带及部分: Resting-state research in unmedicated bipolar disorder found lower connectivity in some default, parietal and frontal regions and higher connectivity in temporal-pole, anterior-cingulate and limbic-related regions.
strings.精神分裂症默认网络综述：汇总该网络的活动、结构连接、功能连接及其与任务相关网络关: A review of the default network in schizophrenia summarized changes in activity, structural and functional connectivity, and relationships with task-related networks.
strings.双相抑郁的荟萃分析：默认网络不同区域既有连接降低，也有连接升高，方向随具体位置而: A meta-analysis of bipolar depression found both lower and higher connectivity across default-network regions, with direction varying by location.
strings.儿童 ADHD 的平衡研究：小脑与运动前区、前扣带的连接降低，并与平衡表现有关。: A balance study in children with ADHD linked lower cerebellar connectivity with premotor and anterior-cingulate regions to balance performance.
strings.首发精神病性障碍研究：在自然情境刺激下，识别出一个连接以下降为主的脑子网络。: A first-episode psychosis study using naturalistic stimulation identified a brain subnetwork whose connections were predominantly decreased.
strings.早期精神病性障碍研究：分析脑活动和网络状态切换，发现部分连接指标降低、状态切换更: An early-psychosis study examined brain activity and network-state switching, reporting reductions in some connectivity measures and more frequent switching, with links to memory and symptoms.
strings.精神分裂症静息态研究：用正则化连接分析识别额内侧、躯体感觉及枕叶等区域的连接降低: A resting-state schizophrenia study used regularized connectivity analysis to identify decreases in frontomedial, somatosensory and occipital regions.
strings.首发精神分裂症研究：多个小脑网络之间的功能连接低于对照。: A first-episode schizophrenia study found lower functional connectivity between multiple cerebellar networks than in controls.
strings.双相障碍研究：额叶眼动区、丘脑和小脑的部分眼动相关连接降低。: A bipolar disorder study found lower connectivity in some eye-movement-related connections among frontal eye fields, thalamus and cerebellum.
strings.跨诊断静息态研究：ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症的程序性记忆网络连接均出现变化。: A transdiagnostic resting-state study reported altered procedural-memory-network connectivity in ADHD, bipolar disorder and schizophrenia.
strings.精神分裂症影像遗传学研究：较高多基因风险与较小海马及较低海马—内侧前额叶连接有关: An imaging-genetics study of schizophrenia linked higher polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi and lower hippocampal–medial prefrontal connectivity.
strings.缓解期双相障碍研究：默认网络和执行控制网络的连接变化与认知、日常功能困难有关。: A study of remitted bipolar disorder related altered default and executive-control connectivity to cognitive and everyday-function difficulties.
strings.比较精神分裂症和双相障碍的整体静息态连接，研究两类诊断是否具有共同的连接受损表现: A study compared overall resting-state connectivity in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder to examine shared patterns of impaired connectivity.
strings.儿童 ADHD 的近红外成像研究：前额叶及运动相关区域连接较低，并考察其与抑制控: A near-infrared imaging study in children with ADHD found lower prefrontal and motor-related connectivity and examined its relationship to inhibitory-control difficulties.
strings.社交恐惧青少年研究：比较是否共病 ADHD，发现默认网络、小脑和枕叶部分连接存在: A study of adolescents with social phobia compared those with and without ADHD, finding differences in default-network, cerebellar and occipital connectivity.
strings.建立正常连接参照模型，再检查精神分裂症、双相障碍和 ADHD 患者的脑网络连接偏: A study built a normative connectivity model and examined how brain-network connectivity in schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and ADHD deviated from that reference.
strings.早期精神病性障碍的荟萃分析：汇总默认、显著性和中央执行网络中的广泛静息态连接变化: A meta-analysis of early psychosis summarized widespread resting-state connectivity changes in default, salience and central executive networks.
strings.ADHD 家庭风险研究：认知控制区域之间的连接在对照中最高、ADHD 中最低，未: An ADHD familial-risk study found cognitive-control connectivity highest in controls, lowest in ADHD and intermediate in unaffected siblings.
strings.遗传风险与脑结构研究：较高 AD 多基因风险与健康老年人及 MCI 人群中较小的: A genetic-risk and brain-structure study linked higher AD polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi in healthy older adults and people with MCI.
strings.纵向研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回: A longitudinal study found faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, and faster ventricular enlargement, in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia.
strings.大型队列研究：APOE ε4 纯合子海马和杏仁核较小，并表现出更明显的随年龄增长: A large cohort study reported smaller hippocampi and amygdalae and greater age-related cognitive decline in APOE ε4 homozygotes.
strings.痴呆随访研究：APOE ε4 携带者的脑室体积增加较快，但同期总体认知量表变化没: A dementia follow-up study found faster ventricular enlargement in APOE ε4 carriers, without the same group difference in concurrent change on a general cognitive scale.
strings.影像遗传学研究：同时考察脑影像和认知指标，报告多基因评分与海马体积及认知功能有关: An imaging-genetics study examined brain-imaging and cognitive measures and reported associations of polygenic scores with hippocampal volume and cognitive function.
strings.AD 多基因风险研究：较高评分与较小海马、较差记忆及更明显的后续认知下降和临床进: An AD polygenic-risk study linked higher scores to smaller hippocampi, worse memory and greater subsequent cognitive decline and clinical progression.
strings.MCI 的 MRI 随访研究：基线海马和内嗅皮层体积有助于预测后续进展。: An MRI follow-up study of MCI found that baseline hippocampal and entorhinal volumes helped predict subsequent progression.
strings.脑结构研究的荟萃分析：左侧内侧颞叶萎缩是较一致的阿尔茨海默病进展预测线索。: A meta-analysis of brain-structure studies identified left medial temporal atrophy as a relatively consistent predictor of Alzheimer's disease progression.
strings.纵向 MRI 研究：海马、颞中回及全脑萎缩和脑室扩大，与 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海: A longitudinal MRI study related hippocampal, middle temporal and whole-brain atrophy, and ventricular enlargement, to the risk of progression from MCI to Alzheimer's disease.
strings.认知下降预测研究：脑室和脑脊液等影像体积指标可增加仅使用临床资料的预测模型所提供: A cognitive-decline prediction study found that imaging-volume measures, including ventricular and cerebrospinal-fluid measures, added information to models based on clinical data alone.
strings.MCI 随访研究：联合脑体积、遗传、淀粉样蛋白及认知指标预测进展，并比较不同随访: An MCI follow-up study combined brain-volume, genetic, amyloid and cognitive measures to predict progression and compared performance across follow-up durations.
strings.BioFINDER 随访研究：AD 多基因风险与认知下降速度相关，部分关联与淀粉: A BioFINDER follow-up study linked AD polygenic risk to the rate of cognitive decline, with part of the relationship connected to amyloid pathology.
strings.遗传研究识别出与疾病进展有关的位点，其中一个变异在另一队列中也与较低的 MCI: A genetic study identified loci related to disease progression; one variant was also associated with lower risk of MCI-to-AD conversion in another cohort.
strings.已有研究在多种精神障碍中观察到显著性网络及相关连接的变化（P1–P3）。系统据此: Earlier studies reported changes in salience-network and related connectivity across psychiatric disorders (P1–P3). The system narrowed this question to right ROI312: is its connection to the salience/ventral attention network lower in both bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum?
strings.系统此前测试过 ROI139 与同一网络的连接，两组虽然都呈下降方向，但重复抽样: The system previously tested ROI139 with the same network. Both groups showed a decrease, but the two directions agreed in only about 51% of resamples. This round tested ROI312 and revised the cited rationale and interpretation of the earlier result after discussion among model agents.
strings.使用 TCP 的静息态脑成像数据，计算右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络: Using resting-state brain imaging from TCP, the analysis measured mean connectivity between right ROI312 and the salience/ventral attention network and compared each patient group with controls. It accounted for age, sex and scanning site, then checked corresponding diagnostic groups in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP, including the influence of head motion.
strings.TCP 中两类患者的连接均较低，UCLA 也呈现相同方向；两组同时保持下降方向的: Connectivity was lower in both TCP patient groups, with the same direction in UCLA. Both groups retained the decrease in 95.1% and 99.3% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed lower connectivity.
strings.双相障碍的感觉运动连接研究，以及精神分裂症中的岛叶和视觉相关连接研究，为系统提供: Studies of sensorimotor connectivity in bipolar disorder and insular or visual-related connections in schizophrenia provided clues from related circuits (P1–P3). The system proposed left ROI108's connection to the sensorimotor network as a specific location that might change in both patient groups.
strings.此前，系统发现两类患者的背侧注意—感觉运动网络连接均较低，重复抽样中两组同向的比: An earlier experiment found lower dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity in both groups, with joint directional agreement in about 96% of resamples. The system refined that network-level clue to the previously untested left ROI108.
strings.从 TCP 的静息态脑成像中提取左侧 ROI108 与感觉运动网络的平均连接强度: Resting-state imaging from TCP provided the mean connectivity of left ROI108 with the sensorimotor network. The analysis compared bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls, accounting for age, sex and site, and repeated corresponding comparisons in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP while checking the influence of head motion.
strings.TCP 和 UCLA 中，两类患者均表现出较低连接，且两组同时下降的重复抽样比例: Both groups had lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in about 99% of resamples in each dataset. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP agreed in direction, and the head-motion checks did not reverse the pattern.
strings.系统综合了岛叶、视觉加工和感觉运动连接的研究（P1–P3），提出右侧感觉运动分区: Combining studies of insular, visual-processing and sensorimotor connections (P1–P3), the system proposed a shared change involving right sensorimotor parcel ROI254 and the salience/ventral attention network. Because earlier bipolar research reported decreases in some connections and increases in others, this experiment tested the direction of this particular connection in both groups.
strings.前序实验在 ROI054 与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间观察到两组共同下降，重复抽样: An earlier experiment found a joint decrease between ROI054 and the salience/ventral attention network, with about 95% directional agreement across resamples. The system followed this clue to ROI254 and incorporated the differently directed findings from the literature during its discussion.
strings.用 TCP 静息态脑成像测量右侧 ROI254 到显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均连接: TCP resting-state imaging was used to measure mean connectivity from right ROI254 to the salience/ventral attention network. Each patient group was compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. Corresponding diagnostic data from UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP were then used to check the direction, together with head-motion analyses.
strings.两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中都呈连接下降，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为: Both patient groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 96.9% and 98.6% of resamples. Psychosis results from COBRE and HCP-EP pointed in the same direction, supporting further study of this specific cross-network connection.
strings.既往研究分别报告了注意相关连接降低、精神分裂症整体连接减弱，以及多种精神障碍中的: Earlier work reported reduced attention-related connectivity, lower overall connectivity in schizophrenia and network changes across psychiatric disorders (P1–P3). The system converted these clues into a specific question: is the link from left sensorimotor parcel ROI036 to the dorsal attention network weaker in both groups?
strings.此前 ROI237 与背侧注意网络的连接在两组中均降低，重复抽样一致性约为 98: Previously, ROI237's connection to the dorsal attention network was lower in both groups, with about 98% joint agreement across resamples. This round moved to ROI036. Discussion among model agents also corrected its network assignment, clarifying that the question concerns a sensorimotor–attention connection.
strings.在 TCP 中计算左侧 ROI036 与背侧注意网络的平均静息态连接，比较双相障: The experiment measured mean resting-state connectivity between left ROI036 and the dorsal attention network in TCP, comparing bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls. Models accounted for age, sex and site. Corresponding groups in UCLA, COBRE and HCP-EP provided further comparisons, including checks for head motion.
strings.TCP 和 UCLA 中的两类患者均呈连接下降，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 9: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 94.7% and 96.4% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in the other two cohorts also showed the same direction.
strings.一项跨诊断研究发现，在某种动态连接状态下，双相障碍和精神分裂症等患者的感觉运动网: A transdiagnostic study found lower internal sensorimotor-network connectivity in a particular dynamic connectivity state across disorders including bipolar disorder and schizophrenia (P1). From this, the system proposed a first-round hypothesis: might the shared change also appear in mean network connectivity across the resting-state scan?
strings.利用 TCP 静息态脑成像，将感觉运动网络内各分区之间的连接汇总成一个平均指标，: Using TCP resting-state imaging, connections among sensorimotor-network parcels were summarized as a mean measure. Each group was compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA provided both diagnostic comparisons, and COBRE and HCP-EP provided further psychosis checks, with head motion also examined.
strings.感觉运动网络的平均内部连接在 TCP 和 UCLA 的两类患者中均较低，两组同向: Mean internal sensorimotor connectivity was lower in both groups in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 99.0% and 97.1% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in the other two external cohorts also showed decreases, extending the pattern beyond an individual parcel.
strings.既往研究在精神分裂症中观察到视觉通路连接降低，也发现精神分裂症与精神病性双相障碍: Earlier studies found reduced visual-pathway connectivity in schizophrenia and differences in visual regions between schizophrenia and psychotic bipolar disorder (P1, P2). Another study described altered visual-network organization in psychosis (P3). The system selected right ROI201 to test whether the two diagnostic groups share a decrease in this visual connection.
strings.此前测试 ROI392 与视觉网络时，两组均呈下降，重复抽样一致性约为 78%。: An earlier test of ROI392 with the visual network showed decreases in both groups, with about 78% agreement across resamples. The system retained the predicted decrease and moved the test to ROI201 within the visual network, examining whether the clue extended to another parcel.
strings.从 TCP 数据中提取右侧 ROI201 与其余视觉网络的平均静息态连接，比较两: TCP data provided mean resting-state connectivity between right ROI201 and the rest of the visual network. Both patient groups were compared with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check both groups, and COBRE and HCP-EP to check psychosis, alongside analyses of head motion.
strings.TCP 与 UCLA 都观察到两组连接下降，但共同下降在重复抽样中的稳定程度分别: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, although joint decreases occurred in 82.6% and 91.1% of resamples, respectively. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases. The overall direction agreed with the hypothesis.
strings.跨诊断动态连接研究报告过视觉网络内部连接降低，另外两项研究提供了精神分裂症视觉加: A transdiagnostic dynamic-connectivity study reported lower internal visual-network connectivity, while two other studies provided clues about visual processing in schizophrenia and visual-related connections in bipolar disorder (P1–P3). The system combined these regional and network-level findings in its first round to test shared changes in mean visual-network connectivity.
strings.把 TCP 静息态扫描中视觉网络各分区之间的连接取平均，比较双相障碍、精神分裂症: Connections among visual-network parcels were averaged from TCP resting-state scans. Bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check both diagnoses, with further psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP and additional checks for head motion.
strings.TCP 和 UCLA 中，两类患者的视觉网络内部连接均较低，两组同向的重复抽样比: Both groups had lower internal visual-network connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 97.9% and 93.0% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases, matching the prediction at the level of the network-wide mean.
strings.文献 P1 在多种精神障碍的一种动态连接状态中，观察到显著性网络内部连接下降。系: Study P1 observed lower internal salience-network connectivity in one dynamic connectivity state across psychiatric disorders. In its first round, the system translated this into a test over the full resting-state scan. Discussion among model agents focused the diagnostic scope on bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.
strings.在 TCP 中计算显著性/腹侧注意网络的平均内部连接，比较两类患者与对照，并考虑: The experiment calculated mean internal connectivity of the salience/ventral attention network in TCP, comparing both groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA was used to check the joint direction, followed by psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP and analyses of head motion.
strings.两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中均呈下降，但 UCLA 的共同下降稳定性较弱: Both groups showed decreases in TCP and UCLA, but the joint decrease was less stable in UCLA: it appeared in 89.3% of resamples, compared with 93.8% in TCP. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also pointed downward.
strings.P1 报告了双相障碍和精神病性障碍中多个网络内部连接的下降。系统进一步追问：感觉: P1 reported decreases within several networks in bipolar and psychotic disorders. The system asked a further question: might the connection between the sensorimotor and salience/ventral attention networks also be lower in these two groups?
strings.前序实验曾同时测试 ADHD、双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系，三组都呈下降方向。本轮保: An earlier experiment tested ADHD, bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum together and found decreases in all three groups. This round retained the network connection but focused on the latter two diagnoses. Discussion also removed citations less closely connected to that diagnostic combination.
strings.从 TCP 静息态扫描中计算感觉运动网络与显著性/腹侧注意网络之间的平均连接，比: TCP resting-state scans were used to calculate mean connectivity between the sensorimotor and salience/ventral attention networks. Both groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. The comparisons were repeated in UCLA, with further psychosis checks in COBRE and HCP-EP and consideration of head motion.
strings.TCP 和 UCLA 均观察到两类患者连接较低，两组同向的重复抽样比例分别为 9: Both groups had lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint directional agreement in 97.9% and 91.5% of resamples. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP also showed decreases, while the shared decrease was relatively less stable in UCLA.

strings.利用 TCP 静息态脑成像，计算背侧注意网络与感觉运动网络的平均连接，分别比较两: Using TCP resting-state imaging, the analysis calculated mean dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity and compared both groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. This round continued that exploration by specifying ROI098 as the starting parcel and changing the target to the sensorimotor network, creating a new connection pairing.
strings.使用 TCP 静息态脑成像，计算左侧 ROI098 到感觉运动网络的平均连接，比: TCP resting-state imaging provided mean connectivity from left ROI098 to the sensorimotor network. Both groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked the two diagnoses, while COBRE and HCP-EP checked psychosis, alongside head-motion analyses.
strings.两类患者在 TCP 和 UCLA 中均呈下降，但 UCLA 的差异较小，两组同向: Both groups showed decreases in TCP and UCLA, but the UCLA differences were smaller. Joint decreases appeared in 80.4% of UCLA resamples versus 90.4% in TCP. Psychosis comparisons in COBRE and HCP-EP showed more stable decreases.

The system extended these to a hypothesis of shared reduction between limbic and sensorimotor networks; neither cited study directly tested this complete network pairing.
strings.此前，同一网络连接在双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中都呈下降。本轮保留测量，改为比较: Previously, the same network connection showed decreases in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum. strings.在 TCP 中计算边缘网络与感觉运动网络的平均静息态连接，比较 ADHD、精神分: The experiment calculated mean resting-state connectivity between limbic and sensorimotor networks in TCP, comparing ADHD and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. strings.TCP 中两组都呈下降，但 UCLA 的 ADHD 组差异接近于零，两组同时下降: Both groups showed decreases in TCP, but the UCLA ADHD difference was close to zero. Joint decreases appeared in only 52.3% of UCLA resamples. COBRE and HCP-EP still showed lower psychosis connectivity, so the external results did not establish a stable pattern shared by both diagnoses.
strings.系统参考了 ADHD 共病研究、跨诊断连接偏离研究和早期精神病性障碍的网络研究（: The system drew on ADHD-comorbidity research, studies of transdiagnostic connectivity deviations and network research in early psychosis (P1–P4). It selected the attention–visual connection for testing and proposed a decrease across three diagnoses, although the literature had not directly established a shared direction for this network pair.
strings.前序实验在三类诊断中观察到感觉运动—视觉网络连接下降。本轮保留三类诊断和视觉网络: The earlier experiment observed lower sensorimotor–visual connectivity across three diagnoses. This round kept the diagnoses and visual network but changed the other network to dorsal attention, testing whether the related question would show the same direction.
strings.在 TCP 静息态脑成像中测量背侧注意—视觉网络的平均连接，分别比较 ADHD、: The analysis measured mean dorsal attention–visual connectivity in TCP resting-state imaging. ADHD, bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum groups were compared separately with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked all three groups; COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, alongside head-motion checks.
strings.TCP 中三组都呈下降，但 UCLA 中 ADHD 的差异很小，三组同时下降的重: All three groups showed decreases in TCP, but the UCLA ADHD difference was small. Joint decreases across all three fell from 88.3% of TCP resamples to 52.0% in UCLA. Psychosis results in the other two cohorts still showed decreases, but external support for a shared three-diagnosis pattern was less stable.
strings.ADHD 的认知控制和平衡研究提示部分连接降低，双相障碍研究则提供了感觉运动连接: ADHD studies of cognitive control and balance suggested reduced connectivity in some circuits, while bipolar research linked sensorimotor connectivity with executive function (P1–P3). The system selected the connection from left ROI104 to the sensorimotor network to test for a shared change across these diagnoses.
strings.此前，ADHD 与双相障碍的背侧注意—感觉运动连接均较低，重复抽样中两组同向的比: An earlier experiment found lower dorsal attention–sensorimotor connectivity in ADHD and bipolar disorder, with joint decreases in about 92% of resamples. This round refined the network-level test to left ROI104.
strings.从 TCP 静息态脑成像中提取左侧 ROI104 与感觉运动网络的平均连接，比较: TCP resting-state imaging provided mean connectivity between left ROI104 and the sensorimotor network. ADHD and bipolar groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. The analysis was repeated for these diagnoses in UCLA, including a check of head-motion effects.
strings.TCP 中两组均呈下降；在 UCLA 中，双相障碍仍呈下降，但 ADHD 与对照: Both groups showed decreases in TCP. In UCLA, the bipolar group retained a decrease, but ADHD differed little from controls. Joint decreases appeared in 49.5% of external resamples, so the shared pattern was not stably reproduced.
strings.视觉网络研究报告了跨诊断连接降低，双相障碍研究也描述了杏仁核与视觉网络之间的变化: Visual-network research reported transdiagnostic connectivity reductions, while bipolar research described changes between amygdala subregions and the visual network (P1–P3). The system extended these clues to the overall visual–limbic connection, testing a shared decrease in both groups.
strings.前序实验测的是三类诊断的视觉网络内部连接，并观察到共同下降。本轮将测试从视觉网络: The earlier experiment measured internal visual-network connectivity across three diagnoses and found joint decreases. This round moved from within-network connectivity to the visual–limbic connection and focused on bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.
strings.用 TCP 静息态脑成像计算视觉网络与边缘网络的平均连接，比较两类患者与对照，并: TCP resting-state imaging was used to calculate mean visual–limbic connectivity. Both patient groups were compared with controls, accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA checked both diagnoses, COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, and head motion was also examined.
strings.TCP 中两组均呈下降，但 UCLA 的两组差异都较小，共同下降的重复抽样比例仅: Both groups showed decreases in TCP, but both UCLA differences were small, with joint decreases in only 45.9% of resamples. Psychosis results in COBRE and HCP-EP still pointed downward, but the overall external pattern did not support a stable effect shared by both diagnoses.
strings.已有研究发现，较高的阿尔茨海默病多基因风险与较小的海马有关（P1）。系统据此提出: Earlier research linked higher Alzheimer's disease polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi (P1). The system therefore proposed using ADNI genetic scores and baseline MRI to examine the relationship in another group of participants.
strings.先在 ADNI1/GO/2 中比较不同遗传风险评分对应的海马大小，再用 ADNI: The analysis first compared hippocampal size across genetic-risk scores in ADNI1/GO/2, then repeated the analysis in ADNI3. Hippocampal volume was adjusted for head size. Models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with different association approaches used to check consistency.
strings.内部分析仅呈较弱的负向关联，外部线性分析则略偏正向，相关系数分别为 −0.094: The internal association was weakly negative, whereas the external linear association was slightly positive, with correlations of −0.094 and 0.046. None of the approaches in either dataset met the corrected statistical criterion, so this experiment did not support the proposed higher-score–smaller-hippocampus relationship.
strings.已有随访研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在进展至痴呆后，内嗅皮层萎缩较快（P1）: A previous follow-up study found faster entorhinal atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers after progression to dementia (P1). The system translated that longitudinal clue into a baseline question: do people with more ε4 copies also have smaller entorhinal cortices?
strings.用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因型与结构 MRI，比较 APOE ε4 拷贝数与: Genotype and structural MRI data from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to relate APOE ε4 copy number to entorhinal volume, followed by the same analysis in ADNI3. Volume was adjusted for head size, and models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site. Different statistical approaches were compared.
strings.ε4 拷贝数更多与较小内嗅皮层相关，内部和外部线性分析的相关系数分别为 −0.1: More ε4 copies were associated with smaller entorhinal volume. Linear correlations were −0.141 internally and −0.158 externally, both meeting the corrected statistical criterion. Robust regression supported the same direction, while rank-based association met the criterion only in the external analysis.
strings.既有队列研究观察到，携带两个 APOE ε4 拷贝的人海马较小（P1）。系统进一: An earlier cohort study observed smaller hippocampi in people with two APOE ε4 copies (P1). The system extended this to a dosage test across zero, one and two copies, asking whether increasing copy number corresponds to a graded difference in hippocampal volume.
strings.将 ADNI1/GO/2 的 APOE ε4 拷贝数与基线海马 MRI 体积进行: The analysis related APOE ε4 copy number to baseline hippocampal MRI volume in ADNI1/GO/2, then repeated the test in ADNI3. It accounted for head size, age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with rank-based association and robust regression used to check agreement across approaches.
strings.内部与外部线性分析均发现 ε4 拷贝数更多对应海马较小，相关系数分别为 −0.1: Internal and external linear analyses both linked more ε4 copies to smaller hippocampi, with correlations of −0.185 and −0.160, each meeting the corrected statistical criterion. Robust regression agreed. The external rank-based association remained negative but did not meet that criterion.
strings.APOE ε4 与较快颞中回萎缩的既有观察（P1），使系统把关注点从海马扩展到外: An earlier observation linking APOE ε4 to faster middle temporal atrophy (P1) prompted the system to extend its focus beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. This experiment concerned baseline size: do people with more ε4 copies have smaller middle temporal gyri?
strings.利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因型和结构 MRI，检验 ε4 拷贝数与颞中回体: Genotype and structural MRI from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to test the relationship between ε4 copy number and middle temporal volume, followed by an ADNI3 check. The analysis accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site, comparing linear, rank-based and robust approaches.
strings.两批数据的表现不同：内部线性关联接近于零（r = −0.034），外部则为较明确: The datasets differed: the internal linear association was close to zero (r = −0.034), while the external association was more clearly negative (r = −0.199). None of the three internal approaches met the corrected statistical criterion, whereas all three external approaches did. Support therefore came primarily from the external cohort.
strings.此前研究发现 APOE ε4 携带者的脑室扩大速度更快（P1）。系统据此检验一个: Previous research found faster ventricular enlargement in APOE ε4 carriers (P1). The system used this to test a related but different question: is ε4 copy number associated with ventricular size at baseline?
strings.在 ADNI1/GO/2 中关联 ε4 拷贝数与基线脑室体积，并在 ADNI3: The experiment related ε4 copy number to baseline ventricular volume in ADNI1/GO/2 and repeated the analysis in ADNI3. Volume was adjusted for head size. Models accounted for age, sex, education, genetic background and site, with different association methods checked for consistency.
strings.内部和外部线性关联都接近于零，相关系数分别为 −0.023 和 −0.040。其: Both internal and external linear associations were close to zero, with correlations of −0.023 and −0.040. The other approaches also found no association meeting the corrected criterion. This baseline analysis did not support a clear relationship between ε4 copy number and ventricular size.
strings.既有影像遗传学研究将多基因评分与海马体积联系起来（P1）。系统将这一思路收窄到: Earlier imaging-genetics research linked polygenic scores with hippocampal volume (P1). The system narrowed this idea to a gene set implicated by AD-risk GWAS, testing whether a score derived from that set also relates to hippocampal size.
strings.利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基因集评分与海马 MRI 体积做关联分析，再用 A: The gene-set score was related to hippocampal MRI volume in ADNI1/GO/2, followed by a check in ADNI3. Analyses accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site, using different statistical approaches to compare association direction and strength.
strings.内部线性关联很弱（r = −0.016），外部负向趋势较大（r = −0.117: The internal linear association was weak (r = −0.016), and the external negative trend was larger (r = −0.117), but neither met the corrected statistical criterion. External rank-based and robust analyses approached, but did not meet, that criterion, leaving no clear cross-cohort support.
strings.文献 P1 报告较高的 AD 多基因风险与较小海马及后续认知下降有关。系统进一步: P1 linked higher AD polygenic risk to smaller hippocampi and subsequent cognitive decline. The system selected a Mendelian-AD-related gene set for a further test of whether its aggregate score corresponds to hippocampal-volume differences.
strings.将 ADNI1/GO/2 的孟德尔型 AD 基因集评分与基线海马体积进行关联，并: The Mendelian-AD gene-set score was related to baseline hippocampal volume in ADNI1/GO/2, then tested again in ADNI3. Models accounted for head size, demographic factors, genetic background and site. Three association approaches were used to examine consistency.
strings.内部线性关联略为负向，外部略为正向，相关系数分别为 −0.028 和 0.011: The internal linear association was slightly negative and the external association slightly positive, with correlations of −0.028 and 0.011, both close to zero. None of the three approaches in either dataset met the corrected criterion, so the predicted higher-score–smaller-hippocampus relationship was not supported.
strings.已有随访研究发现，基线内嗅皮层体积与轻度认知障碍（MCI）的后续进展有关（P1）: A previous follow-up study related baseline entorhinal volume to subsequent progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) (P1). The system proposed linking MRI at enrollment to whether and when dementia developed, testing whether larger volume corresponds to lower progression risk.
strings.使用 ADNI1/GO/2 中 MCI 参与者的基线 MRI 和后续随访，研究内: Baseline MRI and follow-up from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were used to study entorhinal size in relation to time to dementia over two, three and five years. The analysis was repeated in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.
strings.各随访窗口都呈现体积较大、进展风险较低的方向。内部 5 年分析通过统计校正，风险: Across follow-up windows, larger volume pointed toward lower progression risk. The internal five-year analysis passed statistical correction, with a hazard ratio of 0.56. The external five-year estimate was 0.62 but did not pass correction, nor did the two- or three-year analyses. Directions were similar, but external support was weaker.
strings.对多项脑结构研究的汇总发现，内侧颞叶萎缩是预测阿尔茨海默病进展的一条线索（P1）: A synthesis of brain-structure studies identified medial temporal atrophy as a clue to Alzheimer's disease progression (P1). The system selected the hippocampus and tested the relationship between its baseline volume and subsequent time to dementia in MCI participants.
strings.将 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线海马 MRI 与 MCI 随访记录结合，分析海马: Baseline hippocampal MRI and MCI follow-up records from ADNI1/GO/2 were combined to examine progression risk over two, three and five years, followed by a test in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.
strings.内外部分析均呈现海马较大、风险较低的方向。ADNI3 的 3 年和 5 年分析通: Internal and external analyses both pointed toward lower risk with larger hippocampi. The ADNI3 three- and five-year analyses passed correction, with hazard ratios of about 0.44. Internal analyses did not pass correction, with the five-year result closest to the criterion. Support was concentrated in the longer external follow-up windows.
strings.既有纵向 MRI 研究把颞中回萎缩与 MCI 进展联系起来（P1）。系统进一步询: Earlier longitudinal MRI research linked middle temporal atrophy to MCI progression (P1). The system asked whether middle temporal size in a single baseline MRI already contains information about subsequent disease course.
strings.在 ADNI1/GO/2 的 MCI 参与者中，使用基线颞中回体积及随访记录，分: Baseline middle temporal volume and follow-up records from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze dementia progression over two, three and five years. ADNI3 provided a further check. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4.
strings.内部 3 年和 5 年分析支持体积较大、风险较低，5 年风险比为 0.39。外部: The internal three- and five-year analyses supported lower risk with larger volume; the five-year hazard ratio was 0.39. The external five-year result agreed in direction (0.52) but did not pass correction. A stronger external two-year signal involved few progression events and also did not meet the full support criteria. Validation was not consistent across windows.
strings.已有研究发现，脑室及脑脊液体积有助于预测认知下降（P1）。系统把这一影像线索用于: Previous research found that ventricular and cerebrospinal-fluid volumes helped predict cognitive decline (P1). The system applied this imaging clue to MCI disease course, testing whether baseline ventricular size is related to subsequent time to dementia.
strings.利用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线脑室 MRI 测量和 MCI 随访，分析 2、: Baseline ventricular MRI measurements and MCI follow-up from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze progression risk over two, three and five years, followed by replication of the analysis in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4, allowing comparison of the relationship across datasets.
strings.内部各窗口均未显示明确关联。外部 3 年分析发现脑室较大与较高风险相关，风险比为: No internal follow-up window showed a clear association. The external three-year analysis linked larger ventricles to higher risk, with a hazard ratio of 2.03. The five-year result did not pass correction, and the two-year result was limited by few progression events. Overall, the datasets did not show a consistent disease-course association.
strings.既有研究将全脑体积与海马、脑室及认知指标一起用于预测 MCI 进展（P1）。系统: Earlier research used whole-brain volume alongside hippocampal, ventricular and cognitive measures to predict MCI progression (P1). The system tested whole-brain volume as a global structural measure, examining its relationship to nearer- and longer-term dementia risk.
strings.使用 ADNI1/GO/2 的基线全脑 MRI 体积和 MCI 随访记录，分析: Baseline whole-brain MRI volume and MCI follow-up records from ADNI1/GO/2 were used to analyze dementia progression over two, three and five years, followed by an ADNI3 check. Models accounted for head size, age, sex, education and APOE ε4 to compare risk associations across follow-up windows.
strings.5 年窗口中，两批数据都支持全脑体积较大与较低进展风险相关，风险比分别为 0.5: At five years, both datasets supported lower progression risk with larger whole-brain volume. Hazard ratios were 0.56 and 0.43, both passing correction. The external three-year analysis was also supported, while shorter follow-up results did not consistently meet the criteria in both datasets.
strings.已有研究将 AD 多基因风险与随时间发生的认知下降联系起来（P1）。系统进一步把: Earlier research linked AD polygenic risk to cognitive decline over time (P1). The system changed the outcome to time from MCI to dementia, testing whether the genetic-risk score could help explain differences in the pace of progression.
strings.将 ADNI1/GO/2 中 MCI 参与者的遗传评分与随访记录结合，分析 2、: Genetic scores and follow-up records from MCI participants in ADNI1/GO/2 were combined to analyze dementia risk over two, three and five years, followed by testing in ADNI3. Survival models accounted for age, sex, education and APOE ε4 and compared the direction of the score–progression relationship.
strings.所有随访窗口均未通过校正后的统计标准。5 年时，内部风险比为 1.30，外部为: No follow-up window passed the corrected statistical criterion. At five years, the internal hazard ratio was 1.30 and the external estimate was 0.95, differing in direction. The experiment did not support the prediction that higher genetic-risk scores correspond to faster progression.
strings.文献 P1 发现某个遗传变异与较低的 MCI 进展风险有关。系统将单个变异的线索: P1 linked a particular genetic variant to lower MCI progression risk. The system extended this single-variant clue to a Mendelian-AD-related gene set, asking whether its aggregate score is associated with time to dementia.
strings.在 ADNI1/GO/2 中，将孟德尔型 AD 基因集评分与 MCI 后续进展记: In ADNI1/GO/2, survival analysis related the Mendelian-AD gene-set score to subsequent MCI progression over two-, three- and five-year windows. The analysis was repeated in ADNI3, with models accounting for age, sex, education and APOE ε4.
strings.两批数据的所有随访窗口都未通过校正后的统计标准。5 年风险比分别为 0.86 和: No follow-up window in either dataset passed the corrected statistical criterion. Five-year hazard ratios were 0.86 and 1.13, differing in direction. No stable relationship between this gene-set score and disease course was observed.
strings.ADHD 研究把默认网络连接与症状维度联系起来，精神分裂症研究也发现默认网络和显: ADHD research linked default-network connectivity to symptom dimensions, and schizophrenia research related default and salience networks to symptoms (P1, P2). Together with a transdiagnostic study of frontal connectivity (P3), these findings prompted a test of ROI312's connection to the default network. A shared decrease was the question for this experiment, not an established result of those studies.
strings.前序测试关注双相障碍和精神分裂症谱系中的 ROI100—默认网络连接，两组都呈下: The earlier test concerned ROI100–default-network connectivity in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum, with decreases in both groups. This round moved to ROI312 and changed the combination to ADHD and the schizophrenia spectrum to test the clue in another diagnostic pairing.
strings.使用 TCP 静息态脑成像，测量右侧 ROI312 与默认网络的平均连接，分别比: Using TCP resting-state imaging, the analysis measured mean connectivity between right ROI312 and the default network, comparing ADHD and schizophrenia-spectrum groups with controls while accounting for age, sex and site. UCLA provided both diagnostic checks, COBRE and HCP-EP added psychosis comparisons, and head motion was also examined.
strings.TCP 和 UCLA 中两组均呈连接下降，共同下降的重复抽样比例分别为 80.5: Both groups showed lower connectivity in TCP and UCLA, with joint decreases in 80.5% and 91.0% of resamples. Psychosis results in the other two cohorts also showed decreases. The external ADHD effect was smaller and was the weaker part of the shared pattern.
